problem: Building programmatic interface to Claude Code CLI - how to get multi-turn conversation with structured output
solution: Use --resume with --print and --output-format stream-json. First call returns session_id in JSON response. Subsequent calls: claude --resume <session_id> --print --output-format stream-json 'message'. This gives: (1) True multi-turn with full context and tool memory, (2) Structured JSON output without TUI mess, (3) Prompt caching benefits for efficiency. Don't inject conversation history as text in prompts - it defeats caching and truncates context. Store the session_id and use --resume instead.
